prompt: ECMAScript template TRV bare CR LineTerminatorSequence result
answer:
The TRV of a bare `CR` `LineTerminatorSequence` is a single `LF` code unit: **U+000A**. (The bare `CR` is normalized to `LF`.)  
Source: [ECMAScript lexical grammar](https://kt3k.github.io/ecma262/es2026/ecmascript-language-lexical-grammar/)
